name: Tatsoi

companions.note: Borage deters cabbage worms; good companion for all brassica greens

pnw_notes: Forms a flat, symmetrical rosette of glossy dark green spoon-shaped leaves — one of the more visually striking greens in a fall bed. Extremely cold hardy; flavor sweetens after frost. Can handle temperatures down to the mid-20s °F. Harvest individual outer leaves or the whole rosette.

planting_windows.notes: Sow direct or transplant; give room for the rosette to spread flat
Harvest outer leaves to keep rosette producing; flavor best after first frost
